summary: Find every help center article made stale by the January to March 2026 releases, quoting the stale text and giving the replacement; a good answer lists the 11 stale articles across 7 changes and does not flag the reverted SMS change, historical mentions, untouched plan tiers, regular payrolls, annual filings or the future timesheet import deprecation.

findings.what: add-a-new-employee.md tells admins to go to People > Add person; the January release renamed People to Team and Add person to Add team member.

evidence.quote: 1. From the left sidebar, go to **People > Add person**.
- People > Add person is now Team > Add team member

findings.counts_if: Names add-a-new-employee.md, quotes or clearly identifies the People > Add person step, and says it should be Team > Add team member (January 2026 rename).

findings.what: rehiring-a-former-employee.md has a screenshot caption (deep in the article) showing the People menu with Former employees selected; now Team > Past members.

evidence.quote: *Screenshot: the People menu expanded, with Former employees selected and the Rehire button highlighted on a profile.*
- People > Former employees is now Team > Past members

findings.counts_if: Names rehiring-a-former-employee.md, identifies the screenshot caption referencing People / Former employees, and says it is now Team > Past members (screenshot needs retaking or caption updating).

findings.what: compare-plans.md plan table lists 25 custom earning types for Core; February raised Core to 40.

evidence.quote: | Custom earning types | 10 | 25 | Unlimited |
Core plans can now create up to 40 custom earning types, up from 25.

findings.counts_if: Names compare-plans.md and says the Core custom earning types value should be 40 (not 25), without saying Starter's 10 must change.

findings.what: connect-tallyworks.md is a setup guide for Tallyworks Connect, which is the old name of the BrightBooks sync removed in February (alias only in deprecations.md).

evidence.quote: Tallyworks Connect sends a journal entry to your Tallyworks company file every time a payroll is paid, so your books match your payroll without manual entry.
| BrightBooks sync | Tallyworks Connect (the partner's name before its 2024 rebrand) | Removed | 2026-02-10 | Quillfield integration, or Reports > General ledger export |

findings.counts_if: Names connect-tallyworks.md as stale because the integration (Tallyworks Connect = BrightBooks sync) was removed on 2026-02-10, and gives the replacement: Quillfield integration or the General ledger export. Article should be retired or rewritten.

findings.what: month-end-close-checklist.md step 9 (deep in a long article) tells bookkeepers to confirm journal entries synced in Tallyworks; that sync no longer exists.

evidence.quote: If you use the accounting integration, open Tallyworks and confirm that a journal entry posted for every payroll in the month, dated on its pay date.
**BrightBooks sync.** The partner shut down its third party connection program, so we could not keep the sync running.

findings.counts_if: Names month-end-close-checklist.md, identifies the Tallyworks sync step, and says the sync was removed (replace with Quillfield or the General ledger export).

findings.what: run-an-off-cycle-payroll.md says off-cycle payrolls go straight to processing after Submit; February added a required approval by a Payroll approver (or self-approval by email for single-admin accounts).

evidence.quote: Once you click Submit the payroll goes straight to processing, and funds are debited from your account the same way as a regular payroll.
After you click **Submit**, the run moves to **Awaiting approval**, and a team member with the **Payroll approver** permission must approve it.

findings.counts_if: Names run-an-off-cycle-payroll.md and says off-cycle runs now go to Awaiting approval and need a Payroll approver (or emailed self-approval for sole admins) before processing.

findings.what: paying-bonuses.md comparison table says an off-cycle bonus payroll goes straight to processing after Submit; it now needs approval.

evidence.quote: | What happens after you click Submit | Goes straight to processing | Goes straight to processing |
Regular scheduled payrolls are not affected and still go straight to processing when submitted.

findings.counts_if: Names paying-bonuses.md, identifies the table row, and says the off-cycle column must say it needs approval (the regular payroll column is still correct).

findings.what: quarterly-tax-filings.md says quarterly filings wait for admin approval of the filing summary and are submitted on the due date (held if unapproved); March changed this to automatic submission 5 business days before the due date with no approval wait.

evidence.quote: **3. We submit on the due date.** Halvard submits each approved return on the agency due date.
**2. You review and approve.**
Filings no longer wait for approval.

findings.counts_if: Names quarterly-tax-filings.md and says both parts are stale: filings are now submitted automatically 5 business days before the due date, and no longer wait for (or are held for) approval. Mentioning that corrections are allowed until the submission date is optional.

findings.what: direct-deposit-timing.txt gives a 5:00 pm PT submission cutoff; February moved it to 3:00 pm PT.

evidence.quote: - Submit by Wednesday at 5:00 pm PT
Short answer: submit your payroll by 5:00 pm Pacific time, two banking days before payday, and your team gets paid on payday.
the daily cutoff for submitting a direct deposit payroll moves from 5:00 pm PT to **3:00 pm PT**, still two banking days before payday.

findings.counts_if: Names direct-deposit-timing.txt, identifies the 5:00 pm PT cutoff as stale including the example line '- Submit by Wednesday at 5:00 pm PT' (the Short answer line may be cited as well), and says the cutoff is now 3:00 pm PT (two banking days unchanged). Mentioning the 5:30 pm example is a plus, not required.

findings.what: 2026-bank-holiday-payroll-calendar.md table header says Submit by (5:00 pm PT); now 3:00 pm PT.

evidence.quote: | Holiday | Date | Affected Friday payday | Submit by (5:00 pm PT) |
Payrolls submitted after 3:00 pm PT are processed the next banking day, which can push pay dates back.

findings.counts_if: Names 2026-bank-holiday-payroll-calendar.md and says the table's submit-by time should be 3:00 pm PT.

findings.what: set-up-two-step-verification.md (updated January 22, 2026) says SMS codes are no longer supported; March restored SMS as a method.

evidence.quote: **Important:** As of January 2026, text message (SMS) codes are no longer supported for two-step verification.
Admins who were moved off SMS in February can switch back under

findings.counts_if: Names set-up-two-step-verification.md and says SMS was restored in March 2026 so the article should list text message as a supported method again (authenticator still recommended).

exclusions.what: cant-sign-in.md describes text message verification codes as a working method.

evidence.quote: **Text message:** Codes come from a short code, not a regular phone number.
TEXT MESSAGE CODES ARE BACK

exclusions.why_not: The January SMS removal was reversed in March, so an article saying SMS works matches the current product.

exclusions.what: payroll-deadlines-faq.md mentions the old 5:00 pm PT cutoff.

evidence.quote: Until the February 10, 2026 release, the cutoff was 5:00 pm PT.

exclusions.why_not: Historical mention; the article already states the current 3:00 pm PT cutoff.

exclusions.what: custom-earning-types.md says Starter allows up to 10 custom earning types.

evidence.quote: If you're on the Starter plan, you can create up to 10 custom earning types.
Starter and Plus limits are unchanged.

exclusions.why_not: The February limit change only affected Core; the Starter limit is still 10. (Likewise the 10 and Unlimited cells in compare-plans.md are correct.)

exclusions.what: upload-timesheets-csv.md documents the classic timesheet CSV import, which is on the deprecation schedule.

evidence.quote: Upload hours from a CSV file (classic import)
| Classic timesheet CSV import | Timesheet upload (legacy) | Scheduled | 2026-10-15 | Timesheet importer under Payroll > Import hours |

exclusions.why_not: Removal is scheduled for October 15, 2026 and the feature is still fully supported, so the article is not stale yet.

exclusions.what: run-a-regular-payroll.md says submitted payrolls go straight to processing.

evidence.quote: Regular payrolls go straight to processing once submitted.
Regular scheduled payrolls are not affected and still go straight to processing when submitted.

exclusions.why_not: The approval step applies only to off-cycle payrolls.

exclusions.what: annual-tax-filings.md says annual filings wait for approval and are submitted near the due date.

evidence.quote: If a summary isn't approved by the due date, we'll hold it and keep reminding you.
Annual filings are unchanged.

exclusions.why_not: The March filing change covers quarterly filings only.

evidence.quote: If you've been with us a while, you might remember this menu as People; it was renamed Team in January 2026 and nothing else about it changed.

exclusions.why_not: Historical mention explaining the rename; the article uses the current Team name.

exclusions.what: paying-bonuses.md regular payroll column says bonus payrolls go straight to processing.

evidence.quote: | What happens after you click Submit | Goes straight to processing | Goes straight to processing |

exclusions.why_not: Only the off-cycle column is stale; flagging the regular payroll option (Option A) as needing approval would be wrong.

exclusions.what: cant-sign-in.md mentions a Former employee access link on the sign in page.

evidence.quote: Use the **Former employee access** link on the sign in page and verify with your date of birth and the last four digits of your ID number.

exclusions.why_not: This is a sign in page link for people whose employer left Halvard, not the renamed People > Former employees menu, so the January rename does not make it stale.

mistakes_that_matter: Flagging articles that describe SMS two-step verification as available (the January removal was reverted in March), which would lead support to remove correct instructions.
Missing set-up-two-step-verification.md because it was updated after the January release, leaving customers told SMS is unsupported.
Telling readers the 5:00 pm PT cutoff still applies, or 'fixing' it to anything other than 3:00 pm PT, which causes late paychecks.
Adding an approval step to regular payroll articles, or omitting it from off-cycle articles.
Saying quarterly filings still wait for approval, or applying the automatic 5 business day submission to annual filings.
Changing the Starter custom earning type limit, or missing that Tallyworks Connect is the removed BrightBooks sync.
Marking the classic timesheet import article for removal now, before its October 15, 2026 retirement.
